convergence.pencilVersionNote: Authored on the pinned 0.3.5 exactly (dispatch finding 9); the file imports hemlock-library.lib.pen via a relative URI, so re-export MUST run on >=0.3.5 (0.3.4 loads relative imports/fonts EMPTY).
convergence.exportInvocation: pen interactive --in <file.pen> --out <file.pen>; execute({ input: 'Export(["<frameId>", ...], "png", "<dir>")' }) - default scale 2; the .pen MUST sit at its committed lane path so the relative library import resolves. Re-export verified byte-deterministic across consecutive runs (18/18 sha256-identical).
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1, per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; states.json pixelThreshold 0.03 is the GATE-1 story budget, not this loop's). Targets = NORMALIZED prototype, per-state roots/steps/viewports from states.json, headless Chromium 151 (playwright 1.58), deviceScaleFactor 2, animations/transitions frozen, fonts.google CDN blocked with Heebo/Noto Serif served from pencil/designs/fonts TTFs (the same files the .pen references) via fontconfig. Element capture uses an INTERIOR clip (ceil origin / floor size) so no pixel outside the contract root is compared - the exterior-sliver rule found in iteration 5. input-edited adds a 2.4s settle so the Tab-scroll overlay thumb completes its 1.6s rest-fade (settled thumbs-hidden truth, same doctrine as the scrolled states). Every state self-consistency-gated (two independent renders byte-identical).
convergence.iterationNotes: Iter 1 - initial authoring from the normalized-prototype extraction (paint-ordered draw list; per-line text placement; two-rect border model; nested clip frames): 8/18 within budget, failures 1.0-3.4% (sub-pixel text-snap scatter + focus-ring stacking). Iter 2 - page-space integer text snapping + outline-above-static-below-sticky stacking: 9/18 (modal-open 0.49%). Two rounds were then VOIDED as instrument failures (a synthetic snap-calibration probe anchored on div tops while the extractor records Range-rect tops; its corrections regressed 3 states and were fully superseded - documented, not counted, per the tooling-failure clause). Iter 3 - per-line evidence deltas measured target-vs-export in-distribution (the loop's own compare as the instrument): 15/18. Iter 4 - tightened the delta window (previous-line descender contamination) + input-edited settled-thumb re-capture: 17/18. Iter 5 - interior-clip capture rule (the tooltip's final 1.4% was 73% a single bottom-edge row of page-behind pixels outside the element) + final deltas: 18/18 converged, worst 0.982%, best 0.104%. Residual is cross-rasterizer text AA; horizontal glyph advances agree to 0.5px over 180px runs.
convergence.geometryProbesDetail: Design-rules section 4 vectors asserted on the extraction the frames carry verbatim: G1 table extent 2180 exact (default); G2 wrap 652 / G3 448 exact; G5 col0 210 + table 2240 exact (column-resized); G6 Date 139.36 underfill-stretch + zero h-scroll (transactions-rails); G7 Method+Account hidden, Category visible, 600<=678 fits (priority-hidden); dual-rail pins Date left-edge<=1px / Description at Date width / Amount right-edge<=1px under live 200px scroll (transactions-scrolled); bleed host 520 = viewport (narrow-fullbleed); focus ring 3px at -3px offset (row-keyboard-focus); frame ids == state ids 1:1 verbatim, states.json order.

normalizationRecipe.$note: Identity-value injections (variable already equals the bound token's light value) are recorded in the mapping table and change no bytes: --surface-1/#FFFFFF->sem-background-surface, --border/#EEEDEB->sem-borders-light, --border-strong/#D5D3D0->sem-borders-muted, --ink/#0E0E0E->sem-text-header, --text-body/#403D3A->sem-text-body, --muted/#5E5954->sem-text-meta, --accent/#3A6AF8->sem-text-action|sem-borders-action, --accent-subtle/#EBF0FE->sem-borders-action-faint (created), --taupe-100/#F7F5F0 + --taupe-200/#EDEAE3 + --st-gray-100/#F4F4F5 -> created dataTable band tokens, --tk-btn-accent/#3A6AF8->sem-btnPrimaryBg, --tk-text-inverse/#FFFFFF->sem-btnPrimaryText, --row-hover/#F7F5F0->sem-background-rowHover.
normalizationRecipe.fontSwap: None needed - the prototype is Heebo/Noto Serif NATIVE (design-rules 29, near-identity type reconciliation). Determinism half only: the render blocks fonts.googleapis.com/fonts.gstatic.com and serves Heebo + Noto Serif from pencil/designs/fonts/*.ttf (the exact files the .pen references) via fontconfig.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: control borders (search input, entry cell, select button/menu), subtotal/Total top rules, splitL inset line
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Bill's name says strong but the VALUE is gray-200, which Hemlock's borders-muted role owns (Borders, dividers); Hemlock borders-strong is gray-250 #C0BAB2. Role resolved by what the border does, value identity preserved.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: row keyboard-focus ring + select-option focus ring
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Hemlock's a11y contract names sem-borders-focus as THE focus ring; near-black #0E0E0E in light. Deliberate divergence from the prototype's blue rings - same call GC-001 recorded. Ring geometry (3px at -3px / 2px at -2px) unchanged and probed.
The thumb role exists as a named T3 (gray-300 #B5B1AB). Thumbs render at opacity 0 in every contracted frame (rest-faded truth), so the binding is latent; geometry stays probed.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: placeholders, modal close glyph, modal legal line (--faint)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: The placeholder/faint-text role owns these; light value #716E6A also clears 4.5:1. Role-first over Bill's bespoke gray.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: modal head band border + custom-mode band border (--taupe-border)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Emphasized-border-on-taupe role; Hemlock's borders-dark is taupe-350 #DCD8CB, one ladder step off Bill's taupe-300. No taupe-300 border role exists; creating one for a 1-step delta would fragment the ladder.
The error status roles own the fail-loudly surface; Hemlock's red ramp (#C82320 / #FFEAEA) replaces the Tailwind values. Role-first; the 4px-left-border geometry is unchanged.
The blue pill IS Hemlock's Tag (T3 owner). Wash-over-white computes to exactly #EBF0FE = tagBg; text is exactly tagText; border lightens from computed #C4D2FD to tagBorder blue-300 #A5BCFC.

No green Tag T3 exists; the green pill is a success status chip and the status roles own it. Directly relevant to flags.json PENDING-P1 (pill colour-name vocabulary) - if P1 resolves to semantic statuses, this binding is already there.
Hemlock Button/outline = btnSecondary family: text blue-600 (identity), border blue-300 #A5BCFC (lightens from Bill's accent-blue border). Role-first per the button family.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: row hover / pressed tints - NOT rendered in any contracted frame (design-rules 14: pure-CSS hover cannot survive capture parking)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: The rowHover/rowPressed roles exist by name (taupe values). Bound role-first for the land stage; the blue-vs-taupe divergence is designer-visible via this record - rule 30 lists Bill's values as the roles tokens must express, so a designer ruling the other way re-binds via re-oracle.

tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: --surface-1 #FFFFFF on tooltip, select menu, modal card
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Same light value; the elevated role carries the correct dark values for floating surfaces (navy-600 vs navy-700).
design-rules 29 names this the design-capture judgment call: the serif heading role binds font-secondary.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: modal scrim + overlay shadows (outside every contracted root)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Alpha deltas of 0.0012/0.0008 vs the token values; normalized by injection; both paint outside the element-clipped frames so no frame binds them.
Icon roles over text roles for glyph paint at the same values.
